newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak meets Sudan opposition leader.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak meets Sudan opposition leader.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak held talks on Thursday with Sudanese opposition leader Sadeq al-Mahdi, who fled Sudan last month saying he wanted to overthrow the Islamic government in Khartoum.
It was their first publicised meeting since Mahdi arrived in Cairo last week. Mahdi fled from Sudan to Eritrea in December, saying he wanted to change the Khartoum government with minimum bloodshed.
Officials said the two men met but gave no details.
Mahdi met Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa on Monday. He has also held talks in Egypt with members of the umbrella Sudan opposition National Democratic Alliance.
Mahdi was prime minister when Lieutenant-General Omar Hassan al-Bashir staged a bloodless coup in 1989.

Ties between Egypt and Sudan have worsened in the past few years with Cairo implicating Khartoum in an attempted assassination of Mubarak in Ethiopia in June 1995 and of sheltering Moslem militants bent on overthrowing the Egyptian government.
Sudan has denied the charges and has lashed out at Egypt for allowing the Sudanese opposition to operate in Cairo.
